Ka baseen ni

The document of/by

Nihimiyas

Nehemiah

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Si Nihimiyas suluhuanen te Hari ne si Artasirsis diye te siyudad te Susa. Taheed te diye sikandin, nakarawat sikandin te guhuren meyitenged te me Israilita ne nekewun-a nekeuli ne mareet se peg-ugpe. Nakasasindeg e ka timplu piru ware pad naay-ayari ka matikang wey makepal ne alad te siyudad, sikan naa ka ware egpakaatang te me kuntere te me Israilita ne nakalingut kandan.

Nihimiyas (is/was) a servant of the king that's Artasirsis there in the city of Susa. While he was there, he received a story/news about the Israilitas who first returned home whose situation is difficult (LIT bad/ugly). The temple (has) already been_erected but the high and thick fence of the city hasn't been_repaired yet, so then nothing's blocking the enemies of the Israilitas that surrounded them.

Tenged dutu, migbuyu si Nihimiyas te pegtuhut te Hari ne eggendiye te Hirusalim eyew egbalew-balew egpasasindeg te me matikang wey makepal ne alad kayi.

Due to that, Nihimiyas asked for permission of the king to go to Hirusalim in_order to redoing building (LIT causing_to_stand) of its high and thick fence.

Egkabasa ta man-e te seini ne libru ke immenu te Manama te pegbulig ki Nihimiyas te pegbalew-balew pegsasindeg te matikang wey makepal ne alad te siyudad taliware te pegbalabag te me kuntere dan ne nakalingut kandan.

We(incl) can_read also in this book how God (MS Manama) helped Nihimiyas in redoing building the high and thick fence of the city amidst the hindering of their enemies that surrounded them.

Ka peg-ampu ni Nihimiyas para te Hirusalim

The praying of/by Nihimiyas for Hirusalim

Te bulan te Kislib,[fn] diya a te Susa, ka iney ne siyudad. Te seeye ne timpu, migdaruwe e ne pulu (20) ne leg-un ne mighari si Artasirsis.2 Ne imbayaan a ni Hanani ne sabeka te me suled ku, wey due me matig-Huda ne migduma kandin. Ne mig-insaan ku sikandan meyitenged te me Hudiyu ne nakalibed ded[fn] ka naddakep wey in-uyan diye te Babilunya, wey ka meyitenged te Hirusalim. 3 Ne migtabak sikandan, “Subla ne nabaybayaran seeye se nekeuli[fn] ne nenarakep wey neuyan, wey diyad te prubinsya te Huda, wey impeyilawan sikandan te me lapu ne nangugpe diye te marani ran. Nenaddeetan pad ka me batu ne alad te Hirusalim ne matikang wey makepal, wey nasilaban ka me gumawan kayi.”

In the month of Kislib,[fn] I was in Susa, the capital (LIT mother) city. At that time, Artasirsis had_reigned (reaching) twenty (20) years.2 And Hanani one of my siblings/cousins came_to me, and there_was (some) from_Huda who accompanied him. And they was_asked_by me concerning the Hudiyus that returned_home[fn] from being_captured and taken to Babilunya, and concerning Hirusalim. 3 And they answered, “Those who returned_home[fn] from being_captured and taken, and who are there already in the province of Huda suffered too_much, and they are shamed by the foreigners that live(pl) close to them. The stone fence of Hirusalim that's tall and thick is still destroyed(pl), and the doorways of it have_been_burned.”

4 Te narineg ku seini, duen e re se nakapinnuu ne nakasinehew. Ne miglungku a, migpuasa, wey mig-ampu te Manama diye te langit te pila ne aldew. 5 Ne migkahi a, “He Magbebaye ne Manama te langit, maresen ka wey amana egtahuren[fn] ne Manama. Intuman nu ka me kasabutan nu wey impapitew nu te geyinawa nu ne kene egkabalbalawan seeye se miggeyinawa keykew wey migtuman te me suhu nu. 6 Tengtengi a nikeykew wey pammineha nu ka peg-ampu ku te suluhuanen nu te aldew wey marusilem para te me suluhuanen nu ne iyan ka keet-etawan te Israil. Igpangguhud ku keykew ka me sale ney, wey ka sale te me kaap-apuan ku. 7 Mareet amana ka inggimu ney diye te keykew. Ware ney tumana ka me balaud nu, tulumanen, wey me suhu nu ne impabehey nu kanami te suluhuanen nu ne si Muwisis. 8 [xr]Tantanuri nu ubag ka ingkahi nu te suluhuanen nu ne si Muwisis, ‘Ke kene kew egmatinumanen keddiey, egmegsuwayen ku sikaniyu diye te nalein-lein ne me nasud. 9 [xr]Piru ke eglibed kew keddiey wey egtumanen niyu ka me suhu ku, minsan pad ke egmekegsuwey kew diye te maddiyu ne inged, eg-uyanen ku red sikaniyu diye te inged ne in-alam ku eyew diye kew egsimba keddi.’[fn]

4 At my hearing this, I just sat_down there crying. And I mourned, fasted, and prayed to God there in heaven/sky for several days. 5 And I said, “Oh Lord God of heaven/sky, you(sg) are powerful and (a) very_respected[fn] God. You(sg) fulfilled your(sg) agreement and you(sg) showed your(sg) unchangeable love to those who loved you(sg) and obeyed your(sg) commands. 6 Look_at(sg) me and listen(sg) to my praying as your(sg) servant day and night for your(sg) servants who (are) the people of Israil. I will_tell you(sg) our(excl) sins, and the sin(s) of my ancestors. 7 What_ we(excl) _did to you(sg) is very bad. We(excl) didn't obey your(sg) laws, your(sg) customs, and your(sg) commands that you(sg) had_given to_us(excl) by_means of your(sg) servant Muwisis. 8 [xr]Consider(sg) [embarrassedly] what_ you(sg) _said to your(sg) servant Muwisis, ‘If you(pl) are_ not _faithful to_me, I will_scatter you(pl) to various nations. 9 [xr]But if you(pl) return to_me and you(pl) obey my commands, even though you(pl) become_scattered(pl) to distant places, I will_bring you(pl) there to a place that I have_chosen in_order that you(pl) worship me there.’[fn]

10 “Me suluhuanen nu sikandan wey me etew nu ne inluwas nu pinaahi te dakel ne geem wey kanekal[fn] nu. 11 He Magbebaye ne Manama, pammineha nu ubag ka me peg-ampu ku te suluhuanen nu wey ka peg-ampu te me suluhuanen nu ne egkahale ne egtahud keykew. Ituhut nu perem ne eglampus a te seini ne aldew wey te ighangyu ku te Hari, wey igkeyid-u a nikandin.”

10 “They are your(sg) servants and your(sg) people that you(sg) saved by_means of your(sg) great power and strength.[fn] 11 Oh Lord God, listen [embarrassedly] to my praying as your(sg) servant and the praying of your(sg) servants who are happy to respect you(sg). Permit(sg) [hopefully] that I succeed this day and in my requesting the king, and that I'll be shown_sympathy by_him.”

Te seeye ne timpu, sikeddi ka impiyalan ne talagsendad te inumen te Hari.

At that time, I was the in-charge as a waiter for the drink of the king.

Ka peggendiye ni Nihimiyas te Hirusalim

The going by Nihimiyas to Hirusalim

21 Sabeka ne aldew, in-andaman e si Hari Artasirsis te binu, wey insendaran kud sikandin. Bulan seeye ne egngaranan te Nisan,[fn] te igkarangeb ne pulu (20) ne leg-un te peghari din. Ne seeye pad iya ka timpu ne miglungku a diye te tangkaan te Hari. 2 Sikan naa ka nekeinse sikandin keddi, “Mania te hendue te eglungku ka, ne kene ke ma perem egderalu? Nekey ka inglungku nu?”

21 One day, King Artasirsis was_being_prepared with wine, and I served him. That was the month named Nisan,[fn] in the twentieth (20) year of the kinging by Artasirsis. And that time indeed was yet (the first time) when I mourned there in front of the king. 2 That's why he asked me, “Why is it as_if you(sg) are mourning, and you(sg) don't seem sick? What are you(sg) mourning (about)?”

Ne naaldek a amana dutu.3 [xr]Ne intabak ku ka Hari, “Mahal ne Hari, egkeuyag ka te ware egtamanan! Mania te kene e naa eglungku te nalundus man e ka siyudad ne inlebengan te me kaap-apuan ku, wey nenasilaban e ka me gumawan dutu.” 4 Ne mig-insaan a te Hari, “Nekey naa ka igkeupii nu?”

And then I was very afraid.3 [xr]And I answered the king, “Honored king, may you(sg) live without ending! Why shouldn't I be mourning when the city that's the burial_place of my ancestors has disintegrated, and it's gateways have_been_burned.” 4 And I was_asked by the king, “What do you(sg) want?”

Ne mig-ampu a diye te Manama.5 Ne intabak ku ka Hari, “Ke egkabennalan ke red mahal ne Hari, wey ke igkeupii e red nikeykew, tuhuti a ne eggendiye te Huda te siyudad ne inlebengan te me kaap-apuan ku eyew egbalbalawan ku seini te egpasasindeg.”

And I prayed to God.5 And I answered the king, “If you(sg) favored me honored King, and if I'm pleased by_you(sg), allow me to go to Huda to the city that's a burial_place of my ancestors in_order for me to rebuild it.”

6 Ne mig-inse e man-e keddi ka Hari taheed te migpinnuu diye te kakiliran din ka Rayna, “Egkapilaan kaa riye wey ken-u kaa eglibed?” Ne migkekerew a kandin ke ken-u a eglibed wey impeyipanew ad nikandin.

6 And the king asked me again while the queen was_sitting there at his side, “How_long will you(sg) be there and when will_ you(sg) _return?” And I set_a_date with him when I would_return and I was_sent_off by_him.

7 Ne migkahiyan ku man-e ka Hari, “Ke egkabennalan ke red Mahal ne Hari, behayi a te me sulat para te me gubirnadur ne diye te prubinsya ne talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis,[fn] su eyew egpaliharen a nikandan peendiye te Huda. 8 Ne sulati nu ubag si Asap ka migbantey te puwalasan nu eyew egbehayan a nikandin te me kayu. Iggumawan seini te malig-en ne baley ne matikang ne marani te timplu, ig-alad te siyudad, wey te igbebaley te eg-ugpaan ku.” Ne nabennalan ka Hari te inhangyu ku kandin su intantanuran[fn] e ma te Manama ku.

7 And I said to the king again, “If you(sg) pleased Honored King, give me letters for the governors there in the province on the far_bank of the Iyupratis River,[fn] so_that I will_be_allowed_through by them going to Huda. 8 And please write(sg) to Asap the (one who) guards your(sg) forests so_that I'll be given wood by_him. This is for making_doorway(s) of strong house that's high that's near the temple, fencing of the city, and for making my house.” And the king was convinced by my requesting him because I was looked_after[fn] by my God.

9 Te peggipanew kud, imparumaan a te Hari te me upisyal te me sundalu wey te migmangudde. Te pegginguma ku diye te prubinsya ne talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis, imbehey kud te me gubirnadur ka me sulat te Hari. 10 Piru nanengnengan ni Sanbalat ne Hurunihanen wey ni Tubiyas ne sabeka ne upisyal ne Amunihanen ne migginguma a eyew egbulihan ka me matig-Israil, wey neepes-epes sikandan.

9 At my going, the king sent officials of the soldiers and of (those who) were on_horseback. Upon my arrival there at the province on the far_bank of the Water of Iyupratis, I gave the letters from the king to the governors. 10 But Sanbalat the Hurunihanon and Tubiyas one Amunihanon official found_out that I had_arrived in_order to_help the (ones) from_Israil, and they were extremely angry.

11 Ne miggendiya ad te Hirusalim wey natateluwan a diye. 12 Te igkatelu ne marusilem, miggipanew a duma te pila ne me etew. Ne warad iya innangenan ku te igkeupii te Manama ne igpeyimu keddi te Hirusalim. Ne ware degma duma ne ayam ne in-uyan ney angin e te asnu ne in-unturan ku. 13 Ne diya a miglihawang te Gumawan te Napu ne egpeendiye te Belun te Salimbaweng wey diye te Gumawan te Basuraan. Ne impitew ku ka me batu ne alad te siyudad ne newugnak pad, wey nenasilaban ka me gumawan kayi. 14 Innendiyaan ku degma ka Gumawan te Sebseb wey ka Lanew te Hari piru ware egkabayaan te asnu ne in-unturan ku. 15 Purisu, migpabulus e naan de diye te Napu te Kidrun, wey impitew ku ka me batu ne alad te siyudad diye. Nataman, miglibed ad te imbaye ku ne Gumawan te Napu.

11 And I went to Hirusalim and I (was) there three_nights. 12 In the third night, I went_around with a few people/men. And I didn't inform anyone of the desire of God for me to_do in Hirusalim. I didn't take any other domestic_animals other than the donkey that I was_riding. 13 And I exited there at the Gate of_the Plain that goes to the Well of_the Monster and there to the Gate of_the Trash_heap. And I looked_at the stone fences of the city that were_ still _caved_in, and its doorways were_burned. 14 I also went to the Gate of_the Spring/Fountain and the Lake of the king but there_was_no way_to_get_through for the donkey that I was_riding. 15 Therefore, I just continued to the Plain of Kidrun, and I checked the stone fences of the city there. Then, I returned to the Gate of_the Plain that I had_passed_through.

16 Ne ware nakanengneng ka me pangulu ke hendei a egpuun wey ke nekey ka inggimu ku. Su ware mem pad Hudiyu ne ingguhuran ku meyitenged te me planu ku, minsan ka me talagpanubad, talahuren ne me etew, me upisyal, wey te duma pad ne egpakabulig te himu. 17 Nataman, ingkahiyan ku sikandan, “Nakita niyu ka mareet ne neula-ula ta. Nareetan ka batu ne alad te Hirusalim wey nasilaban ka me gumawan kayi. Purisu, egbalbalawan ta ka me alad te siyudad eyew kene kid e egkeyilawan.” 18 Ne impangguhuran ku sikandan te intantanuran a te Manama ku wey ke nekey ka ingkahi te Hari keddi.

16 And the leaders didn't know where I had_come_from or what_ I _had_been_doing. Because there weren't yet any Hudiyus that I had_told concerning my plans, even the sacrificers, respected people, officials, and others who could_help in the work. 17 Then, I told them, “You(pl) have_seen our(incl) bad situation. The stone fence of Hirusalim is destroyed and its doorways have_been_burned. Therefore, we(incl) will_redo the fences of the city so_that we(incl) won't be_ashamed.” 18 And I storied them that I had_been_cared_for by my God and what the king had_said to_me.

Ne migkahi sikandan, “Uya, egbalbalawan ta ka me alad.” Purisu, migpangandam e sikandan eyew te pegbunsud te himu.19 Piru te nanengnengan seini ni Sanbalat ne Hurunihanen wey ni Tubiyas ne sabeka ne upisyal ne Amunihanen, wey ni Gisim ne Arabihanen, ingngisiyan key e nikandan wey imbaley-baley. Ne migkahi sikandan, “Nekey-a seini se eggimuwen niyu? Migsuman-suman kew bes ne egkuntere te Hari?”

And they said, “Yes, we(incl) will_redo the fences.” Therefore, they prepared(pl) in_order for beginning the work.19 But when Sanbalat the Hurunihanon and Tubiyas one Amunihanon official, and Gisim the Arabihanon found_out, we(excl) were laughed_at by them and mocked. And they said, “What is this that you(pl) are_doing? Are_ you(pl) _thinking of opposing the king?”

20 Ne migtabak a, “Eglampus key pinaahi te bulig te Magbebaye ne Manama te langit. Ne sikanami se me suluhuanen din, igpabulus ney ka pegbalew-balew te matikang wey makepal ne alad ne batu. Piru sikaniyu, ware mule baad niyu kayi, wey ke katenged naa, wey ke itulan naa kayi te Hirusalim.”

20 And I replied, “We(excl) will_succeed by_means_of the help of the Lord God of heaven/sky. And we(excl) are servants of_him, we(excl) will_continue the redoing of the high and thick fence that's stone. But you(pl), you(pl) have_no part/portion in here, or authority/right, or pleading story here in Hirusalim.”

Ka pegbalew-balew te alad te Hirusalim

The redoing of the fence of Hirusalim

31 Ne iyan migbalew-balew te Gumawan te Karniru si Iliyasib ne Labew ne Talagpanubad wey ka me duma rin ne talagpanubad. Te neimpusan dan e ka pegbalew-balew te me gumawan, inhalad dan e seini. Inhalad dan man-e ka Matikang ne Baley te Sabeka ne Gatus, wey ka Matikang ne Baley ni Hananil.

31 And the (one who) redid the Sheep Gate was Iliyasab the Prominent Sacrificer and his companion sacrificers. When they had_finished the doorways, they dedicated it. They also dedicated the Tall House of One Hundred, and the Tall House of Hananil.

2 Ne iyan migbalew-balew te alad ne sumpul dutu ka keet-etawan te Hiriku, wey iyan migbalew-balew te lein ne sumpul si Sakur ne anak ni Imri.

2 And the (ones who) redid the next portion of the wall there (were) the people of Hiriku, and the (one who) redid another portion (was) Sakur the child of Imri.

3 Ne iyan migbalew-balew te Gumawan te Isda ka me kabuhalan ni Hasina. Intangen dan ka me sungkaleg te lekeb, ka me lekeb, wey ka me balabag ne igpagul kayi.

3 And the (ones who) redid the Gate of_the Fish (were) the descendants of Hasina. They attached the posts for the door(s), the doors, and the cross-pieces for locking it.

4 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad te sumpul ne baad te alad si Mirimut ne anak ni Uriyas wey apu ni Hakus. Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad te sumpul man-e ne baad si Misulam ne anak ni Birikiyas wey apu ni Misisabil.

4 And the (one who) repaired the next portion of the fence (was) Mirimut the child of Uriyas and grandchild of Hakus. And the (one who) repaired the next again portion (was) Misulam the child of Birikiyas and grandchild of Misisabil.

Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad te sumpul man-e ne baad si Saduk ne anak ni Baana.5 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad te sumpul ne baad ka keet-etawan te Tikuwa. Piru ware himuwa te me talahuren ne etew te Tikuwa ka igpeyimu kandan te me pangulu ran te trabahu.

And the (one who) repaired the next again portion (was) Saduk the child of Baana.5 And the (ones who) repaired the next portion (were) the people of Tikuwa. But the respected persons there in Tikuwa didn't do which was_assigned to_them by their leaders.

6 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad te Tapey[fn] ne Gumawan si Huyada ne anak ni Pasiya wey si Misulam ne anak ni Bisudiyas. Intangen dan ka me sungkaleg te lekeb, ka me lekeb, wey ka me balabag ne igpagul kayi.

6 And the (ones who) repaired the Old[fn] Doorway (was) Huyada the child of Pasiya and Misulam the child of Bisudiyas. They attached the posts of the door(s), the doors, and the cross-pieces for locking them.

7 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad migsinundul te sumpul ne baad te alad si Milatiyas ne matig-Gibyun, si Hadun ne matig-Mirunut, wey ka me lukes ne me matig-Gibyun wey me matig-Mispa. Ka seini ne me lungsud, immanduan te gubirnadur te prubinsya ne talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis.

7 And the (ones who) repaired the following fence/wall (were) Milatiyas who (was) from_Gibyun, Hadun who (was) from_Mirunut, and the males who (were) from_Gibyun and from_Mispa. These towns, were_ruled by the governor of the province on the far_bank of Iyupratis.

8 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad migsinundul kandan si Usil ne anak ni Harayas ne talagsayab te bulawan.

8 And the (ones who) repaired following them (were) Usil the child of Harayas the forger of gold.

Mig-ayad-ayad migsinundul kandin si Hananiyas ne sabeka te me talaggimu te me peemut. Ne naay-ayaran dan ka alad te Hirusalim taman diye te egngaranan te Maluag ne Alad.

Hananiyas one of the makers of perfume repaired following him. And they repaired the wall of Hirusalim up to the Wide Fence.

9 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad migsinundul kandan ka anak ni Hur ne si Ripayas ne pangulu te katenge ne distritu te Hirusalim.

9 And the (one who) repaired following them (was) Ripayas the child of Hur who was the leader of half of the district of Hirusalim.

10 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad migsinundul diye te egkatangkaan te baley rin si Hidayas ne anak ni Harumap.

10 And the (one who) repaired following there in front of his house (was) Hidayas the child of Harumap.

Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad migsinundul kandin si Hatus ne anak ni Hasabniyas.

And the (one who) repaired following him (was) Hatus the child of Hasabniyas.

11 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad migsinundul te lein ne baad wey te Matikang ne Baley ne Hilutuanan te Paan si Malkiyas ne anak ni Harim wey si Hasub ne anak ni Pahat-Muwab.

11 And the (ones who) repaired a following different section and the Tall House for Baking Bread (were) Malkiyas the child of Harim and Hasub the child of Pahat-Muwab.

12 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad migsinundul si Salum ne anak ni Haluhis ne pangulu te katenge ne distritu te Hirusalim. Iyan migbulig kandin ka anak din ne me malitan.

12 And the (one who) repaired following (was) Salum the child of Haluhis the leader of half of the district of Hirusalim. The (ones who) helped him (were) his female children.

13 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad te Gumawan te Napu si Hanun wey ka me mahinged te Sanuwa. Imbalbalawan dan seini wey intangen dan ka me sungkaleg te lekeb wey me balabag ne igpagul kayi. Nakaayad-ayad sikandan te me 440 ne mitrus ne alad taman te Gumawan te Basuraan.

13 And the (ones who) repaired the Gate of_the Plain (were) Hanun and the locals of Sanuwa. They replaced it and they attached the posts for the doors and cross-pieces for locking them. They were_able_to_repair about 440 meters of the fence until the Gate of_the Trash_place.

14 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad te gumawan ne egngaranan te Basuraan si Malkiyas ne anak ni Rikab ne pangulu te distritu te Bit-Hakirim. Imbalbalawan din seini te eggimu wey intangen din ka me sungkaleg te lekeb, ka me lekeb, wey ka me balabag ne igpagul kayi.

14 And the (one who) repaired the doorway named Trash_place (was) Malkiyas the child of Rikab the leader of the district of Bit-Hakirim. He replaced it and he attached the posts of the doors, the doors, and the cross-pieces for locking them.

15 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad te Gumawan te Sebseb ka anak ni Kulhusi ne si Salum ne pangulu te distritu te Mispa. Imbalbalawan din seini, in-atepan wey intangen din ka me sungkaleg te lekeb, ka me lekeb, wey ka me balabag ne igpagul kayi. Ne imbalbalawan din man-e ka alad te linew ne egngaranan te Sila ne marani te pinamulaan te Hari, taman te haheran ne puun te siyudad ni Hari Dabid.

15 And the (one who) repaired the Gate of_the Spring/Fountain (was) the child of Kulhusi who's Salum the leader of the district of Mispa. He replaced it, roofed_it and he attached the posts of the door, the doors, and the cross-pieces for locking them. And he also replaced the fence of the lake named Sila that's near the garden of the king, unto the stairway from the city of King Dabid.

16 Ne iyan mig-ayad-ayad migsinundul kandin ka anak ni Asbuk ne si Nihimiyas ne pangulu te katenge ne distritu te Bitsur. In-ay-ayaran din ka egkatangkaan te inlebengan ki Dabid, taman te limuranan te weyig, wey te Baley te me Bahani.

Ka pegkuntere ki Nihimiyas

The opposing of Nihimiyas

41 Te pegkarineg ni Sanbalat ne gubirnadur te Samarya te egbalbalawan ney ka batu ne alad, nalanglangetan sikandin. Ne indali-dian din ka me Hudiyu. 2 Ne migkahi sikandin diye te tangkaan te me duma rin wey te me sundalu te Samarya, “Nekey-a ka eggimuwen te seini se luyeg ne me Hudiyu? Egbalbalawan dan ubag ka alad te Hirusalim? Migsuman-suman buwa sikandan ne egkeimpusan dan te senge-kaaldew re ka pegbalew-balew te alad wey egpanubaran dan e? Migsuman-suman buwa sikandan ne egkalimud dan pad ka nenasilaban wey nallupet e ne me batu?”

41 When Sanbalat the governor of Samarya heard that we(excl) were redoing the stone fence, he was_ very _angry. And he jeered at the Hudiyus. 2 And he said in_front_of his companions and the soldiers of Samarya, “What are these feeble Hudiyus doing? Are they [embarrassedly] redoing the fence of Hirusalim? Maybe they think that the redoing of the fence will_be_finished by them in just one day so_that they can_sacrifice? Maybe they think that the burned and crushed stones can_ still _be_put_together by them?”

3 Ne migkahi degma si Tubiyas ne Amunihanen ne migpinnuu diye te dulug ni Sanbalat, “Malehet sika. Egkatempag ka inggimu ran ne alad ne batu minsan ke laku re ka egpamaneyik!”

3 And Tubiyas the Amunihanon that was sitting there next to Sanbalat also said, “That's correct. The stone fence that they've made will_cave_in even if it's just a civet_cat that climbs_it!”

4 Ne seeye naa ka mig-ampu a, “Pammineha key, Manama ney, su indali-dian key. Eglibed perem kandan ka indali-di dan kanami. Egkaamin perem ka karatuan dan wey egkarakep sikandan wey eg-uyanen diye te lein ne inged. 5 Kene nu pasayluwa sikandan te mareet ne hinimuwan dan, wey kene nu lingawi ka me sale dan, su inlemetan ke ma nikandan diye te me tangkaan te migtrabahu te alad.”

4 And that's why I prayed, “Listen_to us(excl), our(excl) God, because we(excl) are_being_jeered_at. May their jeering at us(excl) return to_them. May their wealth run_out and they be_captured and be_taken to a different place. 5 Don't(sg) forgive them for their evil actions, and don't(sg) forget their sins, because you(sg) were mocked/insulted by them in_front_of (those who) were_working on the fence.”

6 Sikan naa ka nabalbalawan ney ka batu ne alad taman te natenge e ka katikang kayi, su amana ma ne maahet-ahet ka me etew ne egtrabahu.

6 So then we(excl) have done the stone fence unto half of its height, because the people were_ very _eager to work.

7 Piru te pegkarineg ni Sanbalat, wey ni Tubiyas, wey te me Arabihanen, me Amunihanen, me matig-Asdud ne nakapabulus ded ka peg-ayad-ayad te batu ne alad te Hirusalim, wey nasengsengan e ka me lungag, nalanglangetan sikandan. 8 Purisu migplanu sikandan langun ne eglusuran dan ka Hirusalim eyew egkasamuk. 9 Piru mig-ampu key te Manama ney wey due impabantey ney te maaldew wey te marusilem su eyew due egpakabantey kanami puun kandan.

7 But when Sanbalat, and Tubiyas, and the Arabihanons, Amunihanons, and the (ones) from_Asdud heard that the repairing of the stone fence of Hirusalim was just continuing, and that the holes were_plastered_over, they were_very_angry. 8 Therefore they all planned to invade Hirusalim in_order_that it_become_disturbed. 9 But we(excl) prayed to our(excl) God and we(excl) put_(someone)_on_guard daytime and nighttime so that (someone) can guard on_us(excl) from them.

10 Ne migkahi ka me matig-Huda, “Migmagguye e ka me trabahanti, wey miglatambu pad ka nallupet ne me batu ne egpangaween ney. Kene ney egkeimpusan te egbalew-balew ka batu ne alad.”

10 And the (ones) from_Huda said, “The workers have_become_weak, and the crushed stone that we(excl) have_removed(pl) is still piled_up. We(excl) can't finish redoing the stone fence.”

11 Ne migkahi degma ka me kuntere ney, “Egtigkawen ta sikandan te eglusud taheed te kene pad sikandan egpakanengneng wey egpakakita kanta, wey egpangimatayan ta sikandan eyew egkeengked e ka himu ran.” 12 Ne ka me Hudiyu ne nangugpe diye te marani ran, nangendiye te kanami wey layun key nikandan panpanayi ne eglusuran key iya te me kuntere ney.[fn] 13 Purisu, due impabantey ku diye te liyu te kinariraleman te me baad ne nalunglungahan pad ne batu ne alad. Immegduma-ruma ku pabantaya te batu ne alad ka me taltalagduma wey naatul te me kampilan, me deldeg, wey me pane.

11 And our(excl) enemies also said, “We(incl) will unexpectedly invade before they know_about or can_see us(incl), and we(incl) will_kill them so_that their work becomes_abandoned.” 12 And the Hudiyus that live near them, went to us(excl) and we(excl) were always warned by_them that we(excl) would indeed be invaded by our(excl) enemies.[fn] 13 Therefore, I had_(someone)_guard there on the other_side of the lowest portions of the still holed fence. I had_ related_groups work_together _guarding the stone fence and issued with swords, spears, and bows.

14 Ne inleuy ku ka me etew wey ingkahiyan ku ka me talahuren ne me etew, me upisyal, wey ka duma ne keet-etawan, “Kene kew kaaldek te me kuntere ta. Tantanuri niyu ne maresen wey kein-inuwan ka Magbebaye ne Manama. Pakig-ehet kew para due keupianan te me suled niyu ne me lukes, me anak niyu, me asawa niyu, wey te me ugpaan niyu.” 15 Te nahuhuran e ka me kuntere ney ne nanengnengan ney e ka implanu ran wey nakita ran ne indereetan te Manama ka implanu ran, inliberan ney e langun ka himu ney ne eg-ayad-ayad te batu ne alad.

14 And I inspected the people and I told the respected persons, officials, and the other people, “Don't(pl) be_afraid of our(incl) enemies. Notice(pl) that the Lord God is powerful and amazing. Fight(pl) for peace/prosperity for your(pl) male siblings/cousins, your(pl) children, your(pl) spouses, and for your(pl) homes.” 15 When our(excl) enemies were_told that we(excl) knew what_ they _had_planned and they saw that God had_destroyed what_ they _had_planned, we(excl) returned to all of our(excl) work repairing the stone fence.

16 Puun te seeye ne aldew, nabaad ka me etew te daruwa. Ka senge-baad migtrabahu wey ka senge-baad migbantey, wey due me deldeg dan, me kalasag, wey me pane wey migsaluub te putew ne dingding te kumeng. Ne migbehey ka me pangulu te igkabulig dan[fn] te me matig-Huda ne migbalew-balew te alad. 17 Ne seeye se tigbaba te me batu, migtrabahu ne limang de ne belad ka inggamit wey ka limang ne belad, inggen-gen te panganiban. 18 Ne migsiniket te kampilan ka langun ne migtrabahu wey diye migsesasindeg te dulug ku ka etew ne talagparahing te trumpita. 19 Ne ingkahiyan ku ka me talahuren ne me etew, ka me upisyal, wey ka me etew, “Dakel wey maluag ka eg-alaren ta wey nekegdiyu-diyu ki. 20 Sikan naa ke egkarineg niyu ka dahing te trumpita, dagdahew kew hengkayi te keddi. Ne egpangabangan ki te Manama te pegpakig-ehet kandan.” 21 Purisu migpabulus key migtrabahu puun te egkaliwaswas taman te egkasagkup, wey imbantayan key te senge-baad te me etew ne due me deldeg.

16 From that day, the people were_divided into two (groups). One portion worked and one portion guarded, and they had spears, shields, and bows and dressed in iron chest blocker(s). And the leaders give what_they_can help[fn] of the (ones) from_Huda who were redoing the fence. 17 And those carriers of the stones, worked just using one hand/arm and the other hand/arm, held weapon(s). 18 And all the workers belted_on a long single-edged sword and the person who is a sounder of the trumpet stood at my side. 19 And I told the respected persons, the officials, and the people, “What_ we(incl) _are_fencing is big and wide and we(excl) are_far_apart. 20 That's why if you(pl) hear the sound of the trumpet, immediately come_here(pl) to me. And we(incl) will_be_defense by our(incl) God to fight with them.” 21 Therefore we(excl) continued working from dawn until dusk, and we(excl) were_guarded by one portion of people that had spears.

22 Te seeye degma ne aldew, imbanasalan ku ka me etew ne ware mig-ugpe te Hirusalim wey ka me suluhuanen dan ne diye eggirehe te Hirusalim tagse marusilem, eyew egkabantayan ka siyudad wey eyew egpekeyimu e man-e te maaldew. 23 Sikan naa ka ware key en iya migluluung te insaluub ney te marusilem—minsan sikeddi, ka me suled ku, ka me suluhuanen ku, wey ka me talagbantey ne migduma-ruma keddi. Ne masihen-gen key re due te me panganiban ney.[fn]

22 Also on that day, I encouraged the people that don't live in Hirusalim and their servants, to stay_overnight in Hirusalim every night so_that the city can_be_guarded and so_that (they) could_ also _work at daytime. 23 That's why we(excl) did not undress what_ we(excl) _were_wearing at night—even me, my siblings/cousins, my servants, and the guards who followed me. And we(excl) just individually_held our(excl) weapons.[fn]

Ka peggusey ni Nihimiyas te prublima

The reconciling by Nihimiyas of the problem(s)

51 Due me alunggun ne migsagsahukul diye te duma ran ded ne me Hudiyu. 2 Migkahi sikandan, “Masulug ka me anak ney wey migkeilangan key te egkeenen ne trigu eyew egkeuyag key.”

51 There were couples that complained to their companion Hudiyus. 2 They said, “We(excl) have many children and we(excl) need wheat to eat so_that we(excl) can_live.”

3 Ne migkahi degma ka duma, “Impamirinda ney e ka me kamet ney, me parasan ney, wey ka me baley ney eyew due egkakeen ney tenged su egkabitil key.”

3 And others said, “We(excl) already mortgaged our(excl) fields, our(excl) vineyards, and our(excl) houses so_that we(excl) have something_to_eat because we(excl) experience_famine.”

4 Ne due man-e migkahi, “Nakapanambey key te seleppi para te buhis ne egbuyuen te Hari te me kamet ney wey me parasan ney. 5 Ne kuntee, minsan nenekeg-iling ka langesa ney, wey ka anak ney ne me lukes iling ded degma te anak dan ne me lukes, napehes key red ne igpeuripen kandan ka me anak ney. Ne ka malehet, ka duma ne me anak ney ne me malitan impeuripen ney e. Piru ware egkeyimu ney su ka me kamet ney wey ka me parasan ney, naangken man-e te duma ne etew.”

4 And there were also (some) that said, “We(excl) borrowed money for taxes that are requested by the king for our(excl) fields and our(excl) vineyards. 5 And now/today, even_though our(excl) blood is_the_same, and our(excl) male children are_like their male children, we(excl) were persuaded to enslave our(excl) children to_them. And the truth (is), we(excl) have enslaved some of our(excl) female children. But there's_nothing we(excl) can_do because our(excl) fields and our(excl) vineyards, have_ also _been_accepted/owned by other people.”

6 Nalanglangetan a te pegkarineg ku te pegsagsahukul ran. 7 [xr]Ne insuman-suman ku seini paay-ayari wey te naay-ayaran kud seini te egsuman-suman, iyan ku indakeselan te sale ka me talahuren ne me etew wey me upisyal te me etew, wey ingkahiyan ku, “Inleig-leig niyu ka me suled niyu su impaanakan niyu ma ka seleppi ne impasambayan niyu kandan.”

6 I got_angry at what_ I _heard about their complaining. 7 [xr]And I thought_about_(this) carefully and when I had_carefully thought this, I brought_charges(LIT press_down with sin) the respected persons and officials of the people, and I told (them), “You(pl) have_mocked your(pl) siblings/cousins because you(pl) requested_interest on the money that you(pl) loaned to_them.”

Ne impalibulung ku ka keet-etawan.8 Ne ingkahiyan ku sikandan, “Inggimu ta ka langun ne egkeyimu ta eyew te peglekat te me karumaan ta ne me Hudiyu ne nakabelegye diye te duma ne me nasud. Piru tenged te inggimu niyu, napehes e man-e sikandan ne migbelegye te pegkeetew ran diye mismu te kaniyu. Layun te naan de eglekata sikandan?” Ne nenakapeeneng-eneng de sikandan se nenatanengan.

And I caused_to_gather the people.8 And I told them, “We(excl) have_done everything that_ we(excl) _can_do in_order for redeeming our(incl) Hudiyu relatives that were_sold to other nations. But due to what_ you(pl) _have_done, they were persuaded again to sell their selves to you(pl). Must we(incl) always keep redeeming them?” And they were_shocked and were just silent.

9 Sikan naa ka migpabulus-bulus a, “Kene ne meupiya ka inggimu niyu. Keilangan ne eg-ugpe kew ne due kaaldek te Manama eyew kene ki egdali-dian te me nasud ne me kuntere ta. 10 Timul pad, sikeddi wey ka me suled ku ne me lukes, wey ka me suluhuanen ku, migpasambey key degma te seleppi wey te egkakeen kandan. Ne kuntee igpeeneng-eneng tad ka pegpasubla te egsukut te insambayan dan. 11 Ne ilibed niyu kuntee ne aldew ka me kamet dan, ka me parasan dan, ka me ulibuwan dan, wey ka me baley ran. Ilibed niyu man-e ka anak te seleppi ne impasambayan niyu kandan, wey ka egkakeen, wey me binu, wey ka mentika.”

9 So then I continued, “What_ you(pl) _have_done is not good. You(pl) should live having fear of God so_that we(incl) aren't jeered_at by the nations that are our(incl) enemies. 10 What's more, I and my male siblings/cousins, and my servants, also loaned money and food to_them. And now/today we(incl) will_cease the foreclosing_high_interest (LIT child) on_what they loaned/borrowed. 11 And now/today return(pl) their fields, their vineyards, their olive trees, and their houses. Return(pl) the interest (LIT child) of the money that you(pl) loaned to them, and the food, and wines, and cooking_oil.”

12 Ne migtabak sikandan, “Iglibed ney ka me karatuan dan wey kene key e egsukut kandan. Eggimuwen ney e ka ingkahi nu.”

12 And they answered, “We(excl) will_return their wealth and we(excl) won't foreclose on_them. We(excl) will_do what_ you(sg) _said.”

Ne impeumew ku ka me talagpanubad, wey impepanaad ku diye te tangkaan dan ka me pangulu wey me upisyal ne egtumanen dan iya ka impanaad dan.13 Ne inggekad ku ka tabed ku wey intepungan ku ka kumbale[fn] ku wey migkahi a, “Iling kayi ka eggimuwen te Manama kaniyu, te me baley niyu, wey te me karatuan niyu ke kene niyu egtumanen ka impanaad niyu. Eg-aween din perem ka langun diye te kaniyu.”

And I called_for the sacrificers, and I got_ the leaders and the officials _to_promise in front of them that they would indeed obey what_ they _had_promised.13 And I untied my folded girdle[fn] and I said, “Like this (is what) God will_do to_you(pl), to your(pl) houses, and to your(pl) wealth if you(pl) don't obey what_ you(pl) _promised. He will_remove everything from you(pl).”

Ne migkahi ka langun, “Malehet iya!” Ne indeyrey ran ka Magbebaye ne Manama, wey intuman dan ka impanaad dan.

And everyone said, “True indeed!” and they praised the Lord God, and they obeyed what_ they _had_promised.

Ka pegbulig ni Nihimiyas

The helping by Nihimiyas

14 Neyimu a ne gubirnadur te Huda te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne leg-un, bunsud te igkararuwa ne pulu (20) taman te tatelu ne pulu wey daruwa (32) ne leg-un te peghari ni Artasirsis. Ne minsan pad due, wara ad iya migkeen te egkakeen te egkeyimu ne gubirnadur wey iling ded degma ka me suled ku. 15 Piru impeyirapan te me gubirnadur ne nekewun-a keddi ka me etew, wey impanguwa ka egkakeen dan wey ka me binu ran. Impabehey pad man-e sikandan te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne buuk ne pelata. Minsan ka me talagbulig te gubirnadur, mig-ambag-ambag degma migleig-leig te me etew. Piru ware ku himuwa seini su naaldek a te Manama. 16 Ne migpakannekal a ka egbalew-balew te batu ne alad te siyudad wey miglibulung diye ka langun ne suluhuanen ku eyew egbulig te himu. Ne wara a iya migkamkamuney te tane. 17 Ne timul pad kayi, wara a migbuyu te minsan nekey, minsan sikeddi ka migpakeen te 150 ne me Hudiyu wey te me upisyal ran, ware pad labet te me mahaliyug ne egpuun te minsan hendei ne me nasud. 18 Ne tagse aldew, miglapa a te sabeka ne baka wey hen-em ne mallambeg ne me karniru wey me manuk. Ne tagse sapulu ne aldew, migbehey a man-e te langun ne klasi te binu. Piru minsan pad iling due ka inggimu ku, wara a migkuwa te minsan nekey. Nakanengneng a ne mabehat amana seini para te me etew, purisu, wara a migkuwa te minsan nekey ne pegkeen ne para te gubirnadur.

14 I became the governor of Huda for twelve (12) years, beginning from the twentieth (20) until the thirty second (32) year of the kinging by Artasirsis. And even then, I didn't eat the food of (the_one) who became governor and my siblings/cousins were just the same. 15 But the governors who had preceded me had_made_it_difficult for the people, and took(pl) their food and their wine. And they also_caused_to_give forty (40) pieces of silver. Even the helpers of the governor, joined also to insult the people. But I didn't do this because I was afraid of God. 16 And I strived/work_hard redoing the stone fence of city and all my servants gathered_together in_order for helping the work. And I didn't own land. 17 And in addition, I didn't ask for anything, even_though I (am) the (one who) fed to 150 Hudiyu and their officials, not including foreigners/visitors from wherever countries. 18 And each day, I slaughtered one cow and six fat(pl) sheep and chickens. And each ten days, I also gave all kinds of wine. But even_though what_ I _did_was like that, I never take anything. I knew that this was heavy for the people, therefore, I didn't take any food that (was) for the governor.

19 He Manama ku, tantanuri a te langun ne neyimu ku te seini ne me etew.

61 Nanengnengan ni Sanbalat, ni Tubiyas, wey ni Gisim ne Arabihanen wey te duma pad ne me kuntere ney, ne neimpusan ney e te egbalew-balew ka batu ne alad te siyudad wey warad e me lungag kayi, angin e te me lekeb ne ware pad nakatangen. 2 Seeye naa, impeumew a ni Sanbalat wey ni Gisim te miggenendue, “Egkeupian key ne egpakigkita keykew diye te sabeka ne bariyu te Kipirim te napu te Unu.” Piru ka malehet, mareet bes ka tuyu dan keddi. 3 Purisu migsuhu a degma te me etew eyew egkahi kandan, “Dakel ka himu ku, purisu kena a egpekeendue. Kene egkaayun ne egkeengkeran ku ka himu eyew re egpakigkita kaniyu.”

It's_ not _possible that I cease the work in_order to meet with_you(pl).”

Kahi rin pa iya ne egkeupian ke kun ne egkeyimu ne Hari te me Hudiyu. 7 Ne mig-alam ke kun pad man-e te me prupita ne egpataha due te Hirusalim ne sikeykew e ka Hari te Huda. Egkataman ne egkanengnengan iya seini te Hari, sikan naa ka keilangan ne eggendini ka su egpasabutey ki meyitenged kayi.”

5 On the fifth invitation of Sanbalat to_me, I was_sent by_him via his servant a letter that wasn't stuck_down. 6 This is the content of the letter, “It's told whatever nation, even Gisim said that you(sg) [reportedly] are thinking and the Hudiyus to rebel, that's why you(pl) are redoing the stone fence. He also said indeed that you(sg) [reportedly] want to become king of the Hudiyus. 7 And you(pl) also [reportedly] chose prophets that will_inform Hirusalim that you(sg) are now the king of Huda. Eventually this will_ indeed _become_known by the king, that's why it's_necessary that you(sg) come_here because we(incl) can_come_to_an_agreement about this.”

Ne amana migpammineg ka langun ne etew te nasulat dutu.

81 And all the people gathered there at the plaza in_front_of the Water Gate. And they told Isra, the skilled/expert of the Law of God to bring the document of the Law of Muwisis that was commanded by the Lord God of Israil. 2 So then, on the first day of the seventh month, Isra the sacrificer brought the Law to the front of the gathered men, women, and children that can_understand already. 3 And he read loudly the document of the Law there in front of the people who gathered in the Water Gate, from early_morning until noon. And all the people listened intensely at what_was_written there.

4 Ne migsasindeg si Isra, ka talagpanulu te Balaud te Manama diye te ampew te inlantawan ne kayu eyew eggamiten te seeye ne peglibulung. Ne ka migsasindeg diye te igkakawanan din si Matitiyas, si Sima, si Ananiyas, si Uriyas, si Hilkiyas, wey si Maasiyas. Ne ka diye te igkahibang din si Pidayas, si Misail, si Malkiyas, si Hasum, si Hasbaddana, si Sakariyas, wey si Misulam.

4 And Isra, the teacher of the Law of God stood there on top of a wooden raised_platform in_order to use for that gathering. And the (ones) who stood at his right (were) Matitiyas, Sima, Ananiyas, Uriyas, Hilkiyas, and Maasiyas. And the (ones) there on his left (were) Pidayas, Misail, Malkiyas, Hasum, Hasbaddana, Sakariyas, and Misulam.

5 Egkakita si Isra te langun ne etew su matikang ma ka migsasindehan din. Ne ingkayew te me etew ka me belad dan wey migtabak sikandan, “Malehet iya! Malehet iya!” Nataman, mig-usengul e sikandan diye te tane wey migsimba te Magbebaye ne Manama.

5 Isra could_be_seen by all the people because what_ he _stood_on was high. When he unrolled the document, all the people stood. 6 And Isra praised the Lord God, the honored God. And the people raised their hands/arms and they answered, “True indeed! True indeed!” Then, they bowed_low to the ground and they worshiped the Lord God.

7 Ne migsasindeg e ka me etew wey impasabut e kandan ka Balaud. Ka migpasabut kandan iyan ensi Huswi, si Bani, si Siribiyas, si Hamin, si Akub, si Sabitay, si Hudiyas, si Maasiyas, si Kilita, si Asariyas, si Husabad, si Hanan, si Pilayas, wey ka me Libita. 8 Imbasa ran paay-ayari ka Libru te Balaud te Manama wey impasabut dan ka kaluwasan te Balaud su eyew egpakasabut ka me etew.

7 And the people stood and the Law was explained to them. The (ones who) explained to them (were) Huswi, Bani, Siribiyas, Hamin, Akub, Sabitay, Hudiyas, Maasiyas, Kilita, Asariyas, Husabad, Hanan, Pilayas, and the Libitas. 8 They carefully read the Book of the Law of God and they explained the meaning of the Law so_that the people could_understand.

9 Naninehew ka me etew te pegkarineg dan dutu. Pamehayi niyu te egkakeen ka ware egkakeen su matulus para te Magbebaye ne Manama ka seini aldew. Kene kew lungku su ka kahale ne imbehey te Manama iyan egpakabehey kaniyu te kanekal.”

9 The people cried at their hearing this. And Nihimiyas the governor, Isra the sacrificers and skilled/expert of the Law of God, and the Libitas (were) the (ones who) explained to them saying, “This is a holy day to the Lord your(pl) God, therefore don't(pl) grieve or wail.” 10 And Nihimiyas told them, “Go(pl) and eat(pl) delicious food, and drink(pl) sweet wine. Distribute(pl) food to the (ones who) don't have food because this day is holy for the Lord God. Don't(pl) grieve because the joy that's given by God is what will_be_able_to_give you(pl) strength.”

11 Ne impapeeneng-eneng degma te me Libita ka langun ne etew te migkahi, “Peeneng-eneng kew su matulus seini ne aldew. Kene kew lungku.” 12 Ne nangipanew e ka langun ne etew eyew egkeen wey eg-inum, wey egpamehey te egkakeen. Miggale-gale sikandan su nakasabut ma sikandan te impanengneng kandan.

11 And all the people were silenced by the Libitas who said, “Be_quiet(pl) because this day is holy. Don't(pl) grieve.” 12 And all the people went(pl) in_order to eat and drink, and distribute food. They were_happy because they understand what was explained to_them.

Ka Pegsahakeen diye te me Leeb

The Feast in Huts

13 Te igkarangeb ne aldew, miglibulung diye ki Isra ne talagpanulu te Balaud te Manama ka langun ne pangulu te me pamilya, duma te me talagpanubad wey me Libita eyew te peg-ugsi-ugsi te nasulat diye te Balaud. 14 [xr]Ne nanengnengan dan ne nasulat diye te Balaud te Magbebaye ne Manama ne imbehey ki Muwisis ne egpaleleeben ka keet-etawan te Israil te timpu te sahakeen te igkapitu ne bulan, wey diye sikandan egpeuugpaa. 15 Ne keilangan man-e ne igpanengneng wey egbanasalan ka langun ne lungsud wey diye te Hirusalim te seini: “Hendiye kew te me bubungan wey panguwa kew naa te me sugpang te ulibu, leew ne ulibu, mirtul, palmira, wey duma pad ne kayu ne malapung se dewun eyew eggimuwen ne leeb sumale te nasulat diye te Balaud.”

13 On the second day, all the leaders of families, along_with sacrificers and Libitas gathered with Isra the teacher of the Law of God in_order for searching what was written in the Law. 14 [xr]And they found_out what_was_written there in the Law of the Lord God that was_given to Muwisis that the people of Israil were_to_make_huts at the time of the feast in the seventh month, and they were_to_live there. 15 And it's also necessary that the entire town and Hirusalim be_informed and to_be_encouraged of this: “Go(pl) to the mountains and get(pl) branches of olive, wild olive, mirtul, palms, and other trees that have luxuriant leave(s) in_order to_make a hut according to what_was_written there in the Law.”

16 Sikan naa ka nangipanew e ka me etew wey nanguyan te me sugpang, wey nangimu e te me leeb diye te me atep[fn] dan, diye te lama ran, diye te lama te timplu, wey diye te plasa ne marani te Gumawan te Weyig, wey diye te plasa ne marani te Gumawan ni Ipraim. 17 Ne nanleleeb e ka langun ne nekeuli ne naddakep te nangugpaan dan te timpu te sahakeen. Nahale amana sikandan tenged su seini pad man-e neyimu te keet-etawan te Israil ka sahakeen puun dengan te timpu pad ni Huswi ne anak ni Nun. 18 Tagse aldew ne egbaseen ni Isra ka baseen te Balaud te Manama puun te an-anayan ne aldew te sahakeen taman te katammanan ne aldew. Migsahakeen sikandan te pitu ne aldew wey te igkawalu ne aldew, miglibulung sikandan diye te tangkaan te Manama.

16 That's why the people went and brought branches, and made huts on their rooves,[fn] in their yards, in the yard of the temple, and there in the plaza near the Water Gate, and there in the plaza near the Gate of Ipraim. 17 And all who returned_home(pl) that had_been_captured(pl) made_huts(pl) that they lived_in at the time of the feast. They were_ very _happy because the people of Israil did this feasting again since the time of Huswi the child of Nun long_ago. 18 Each day Isra would_read the document of the Law of God from the first day of the feast until the last day. They feasted for seven days and on the eighth day, they gathered there in the presence of God.

Ka peg-angken te me Israilita te me sale dan

Te tatelu e man-e ne uras, impangguhud dan ka me sale dan wey migsimba te Magbebaye ne iyan ka Manama ran. 4 Ne migsasindeg diye te innaggaheranan ka Libita ne si Huswi, si Bani, si Kadmiil, si Sibaniyas, si Buni, si Siribiyas, si Bani ne lein, wey si Kinani, ne migpanaman-taman mig-ampu diye te Magbebaye ne Manama ran.

31 [xra][xrb]We(excl) promise also_that we(excl) won't buy if the foreigners sell anything or food on the Day of Resting, and on holy (LIT valuable) days. And each seventh year, we(excl) won't plant our(excl) land, and we(excl) won't seek_to_recover the debts of others.

32 [xr]Ne egpanaad key man-e ne egbehey key tagse leg-un te hep-at ne gramu te pelata eyew igbulig te eggimuwen diye te timplu. 33 Igbeli seini te paan ne ighalad, te egkakeen ne ighalad tagse aldew, te igpanubad ne me ayam, te ighalad para te Aldew te Peggimeley, te me igsahakeen te Iyam ne Bulan, wey te duma pad ne me sahakeen. Igbeli man-e seini te duma ne igpanubad diye te Manama, wey te igpanubad te pegpalangesa eyew te peglinis te sale te Israil, wey te langun ne egkeilanganen para te timplu.

This will_buy also for other sacrifice(s) to God, and to_sacrifice for bloodshed in_order to clean the sins of Israil, and for all the needs for the temple.

111 Te seeye ne timpu, diye nangugpe te Hirusalim ka me pangulu te me Israilita. Ne migpintut-pintut ka duma ne me etew eyew eg-alam te sabeka ne pamilya puun te sapulu ne pamilya, eyew diye de igpeugpe te Hirusalim, ka matulus ne siyudad. Ne ka duma ne pamilya, diyad eg-ugpe te duma ne me lungsud. 2 Indayan te me etew ka langun ne iyan e eg-uney-uney egkahi te eg-ugpe sikandan diye te Hirusalim. 3 [xr]Ne ka duma ne me Israilita, ka me talagpanubad, me Libita, me suluhuanen te timplu, wey ka me kabuhalan te me suluhuanen ni Sulumun diye nangugpe te me inged dan ne diye te nalein-lein ne lungsud ne sakup te Huda. Ne ka duma ne kabuhalan ni Huda wey ni Binhamin, diyad mig-ugpe te Hirusalim.

And the other people drew_lots in_order to choose one family from ten families, in_order to cause_ (it) _to_live there in Hirusalim, the holy city. And the other families, will_live in other towns. 2 All the (ones who) personally say to live in Hirusalim were appreciated(LIT praised) by the people. 3 [xr]And the other Israilitas, the sacrificers, the Libitas, servants of the temple, and the descendants of the servants of Sulumun lived there in their places there in various towns under_the_jurisdiction of Huda. 24 Ne seini ka me pangulu te me pamilya te Libita: si Hasabiyas, si Siribiyas, si Hisuwa, si Binuy, si Kadmiil, wey ka me duma ran ne migsasindeg diye te egkatangkaan dan ne migdeyrey wey migpasalamat. Migmatabtabakey sikandan ka eg-ulahing sumale te suhu ni Dabid ne suluhuanen te Manama.

27 Te peghalad te batu ne alad te Hirusalim, impeumew ran ka me Libita diye te me inged ne in-ugpaan dan. Ne igpeendiye sikandan te Hirusalim eyew te pegsahakeen wey peggale-gale te peghalad kayi duma te pegpasalamat wey peg-ulahing ne egbalesen te me putew ne basalan, me alpa, wey me lira. 28 Igpeendiye degma ka mangngulahing[fn] ne egpuun diye te me inged ne nakalingut te Hirusalim wey ka egpuun diye te me bariyu te Nitupa, 29 wey ka egpuun degma te Bit-Gilgal, wey ka egpuun te inged te Giba wey te Asmabit, su migbebariyu ma ka me mangngulahing diye te nakalingut te Hirusalim. 30 Migpanlinis ka me talagpanubad wey me Libita te pegkeetew ran eyew egmatulus sikandan, inlinisan dan degma ka me etew, ka me gumawan, wey ka batu ne alad te siyudad eyew egmatulus.

27 At the dedicating of the stone fence of Hirusalim, they had_ the Libitas _called from the villages that_ they _live_in. And they were_sent to Hirusalim in_order for feasting and rejoicing at the dedicating of_this along_with thanking and singing with iron gongs, harps, and lyres. 28 The singers[fn] were_sent_there also from places/villages surround Hirusalim and the (ones) from the Nitupa barrios, 29 and the (ones) also from Bit-Gilgal, and the (ones) from the place/village of Giba and of Asmabit, because the singers had_made_barrios there surrounding Hirusalim. 30 The sacrificers and Libitas made_ them selves _clean, they also made_ the people _clean, the doorways, and the stone fence of the city in_order to be_holy.

31 Ne induma ku ka me pangulu te Huda diye te ampew te alad. Ne mig-alam a te daruwa ne punduk te masulug ne mangngulahing eyew eglingut-lingut diye te ampew te alad, te pegpasalamat te Manama.

31 And I accompanied the leaders of Huda there to the top of the fence. And I chose two groups of many singers in_order to circle there on top of the fence, for thanking God.

Ka sabeka ne punduk migpeendiye te igkakawanan ne balabahan ne egpakatangke te gumawan ne egngaranan te Basuraan.32 Ne migsinundul kandan si Husayas duma te katenge te me pangulu te Huda. 33 Migsinundul degma ka talagpanubad ne ensi Asariyas, si Isra, si Misulam, 34 si Huda, si Binhamin, si Simaya, wey si Hirimiyas. 35 Ne migparahing ka duma kandan te me trumpita ne iyan ka migsinundul ne si Sakariyas ne anak ni Diyunatan. Si Diyunatan anak ni Simaya. Si Simaya anak ni Mataniyas. Si Mataniyas anak ni Mikayas. Ne si Mikayas anak ni Sakur ne kabuhalan ni Asap. 36 Ne ka me suled din ne ensi Asaril, si Simaya, si Milalay, si Gilalay, si Maay, si Nitanil, si Huda wey si Hanani, mig-uyan te me kasangkapan ne igbales te ulahingen iling te inggamit ni Hari Dabid dengan, ka suluhuanen te Manama. Ne si Isra ne talagpanulu te Balaud te Manama ka migpangulu kandan. 37 Te pegginguma ran diye te gumawan ne peendiye te Sebseb, migpamaneyik e sikandan te haheran peendiye te Siyudad ni Hari Dabid, diye te haheran te alad. Inliharan dan ka palasyu ni Dabid wey migpabulus diye te gumawan ne egngaranan te Weyig ne egpakatangke te igsile.

One group went to the right of the boundary that facings the gates named Trash_place.32 And Husayas followed them along_with half of the leaders of Huda. 33 The sacrificers followed also who were Asariyas, Isra, Muslam, 34 Huda, Binhamin, Simaya, and Hirimiyas. 35 And some of them sounded trumpets who were Sakariyas the child of Diyunatan followed. Diyunatan (is/was) the child of Simaya. Simaya (is/was) the child of Mataniyas. Mataniyas (is/was) the child of Mikayas. And Mikayas (is/was) the child of Sakur the descendant of Asap. 36 And his siblings/cousins who (are/were) Asaril, Simaya, Milalay, Gilalay, Maay, Nitanil, Huda and Hanani, brought utensils to beat to song(s) like were used before by King Dabid, the servant of God. And Isra the teacher of the Law of God (was) the (one who) led them. 37 At their arrival there at the doorway going to (the) Spring, they ascended the stairway towards the City of King Dabid, there on the stairway of the fence. They passed_by the palace of Dabid and continued to the doorway named Water that faces east.

38 Ka igkarangeb ne punduk te seeye se egpasalamat, migpeendiye te igkahibang ne balabahan. Migsinundul a te seini ne punduk duma te katenge te me etew. Diye key migbaye te batu ne alad ne ampew te Matikang ne Baley ne hilutuanan te paan peendiye te Maluag ne Alad. 39 Puun diye, migpeendiye key te ampew te gumawan ni Ipraim, te Tapey ne gumawan wey te gumawan egngaranan te Isda, te Titikangi ne Baley ni Hananil wey te Titikangi ne Baley te Mahatus, taman te gumawan ne egngaranan te Karniru. Ne migtuhun key diye te gumawan te Talagbantey. 40 Sikan naa, miggendiyad te timplu ka daruwa ne punduk ne egpasalamat te Manama, wey migsasindeg sikandan diye te egsasindehan dan. Migleus a degma diye duma te katenge te me upisyal ran ne me duma ku. 41 Diye degma ka me talagpanubad ne ensi Iliyakim, si Maasiyas, si Mihamin, si Mikayas, si Iliyuwinay, si Sakariyas, wey si Hananiyas ne talagparahing te trumpita ran, 42 wey ensi Maasiya, si Simaya, si Ilisar, si Usi, si Hihuhanan, si Malkiyas, si Ilam, wey si Isir. Sikandan ka me mangngulahing ne impanguluwan ni Hisriyas te peg-ulahing.

38 The second group of those giving_thanks, went to the north (LIT left side). I followed this group along_with half of the people. We(excl) went_along the stone fence that the top of the Tall House for baking bread towards the Wide Fence. 39 From there, we(excl) went to the top of the doorway of Ipraim, to the Old doorway and to the doorway named Fish, to the Tall House of Hananil and to the Tall House of (the) Hundred, until the doorway named Sheep. And we(excl) reached the doorway of Guards. 40 So then, the two groups that's thanking God went to the temple, and they stood there in their standing_places. I went_straight there also along_with half of their officials that were my companions. 41 Also the sacrificers who were Iliyakim, Maasiyas, Minyamin, Mikayas, Ilyuwinay, Sakariyas, and Hananiyas who sounding their trumpets, 42 and Maasiya, Simaya, Ilisar, Usi, Hihuhanan, Malkiyas, Ilam, and Isir. They were the singers that were led by Hisriyas sang.

43 Te seeye ne aldew, masulug ka impanubad dan wey miggale-gale dan amana su imbehayan sikandan te dakel ne kahalaan te Manama. Miggale-gale degma ka me malitan wey ka me bate. Ne minsan seeye se diye te mariyu te Hirusalim, egpakarineg te kahulub te peggale-gale dan.

43 On that day, they sacrificed many (things) and they made_ great _merriment because they were_given great joy by God. The women and children also made_merriment. And even those distant from Hirusalim, heard the noise of their making_merriment.

Ka peg-andam te ingkeilangan te timplu

The preparing for what_is_need in the temple

44 Te seeye ne aldew, naalam ka me lukes ne egpabantayen te sinabeng ne egtinesan te dasag te me etew wey te an-anayan ne behas te me pinamula, wey te me igkasapulu. Sikandan ka eglimud te me halad puun te me kamet te nakalingut ne me lungsud eyew igbehey te me talagpanubad wey te me Libita su sika iya ka nasulat diye te Balaud. Ne ingkatelesi pad iya man-e te me matig-Huda ka pegtrabahu te me talagpanubad wey te me Libita diye te timplu. 45 [xra][xrb]Su inggimu ran ma ka igpeyimu kandan te Manama ran, wey ka tulumanen te peglinis. Ne inggimu degma te mangngulahing wey te me talagtameng te gumawan ka himu ran sumale te suhu ni Dabid wey te anak din ne si Sulumun. 46 Puun pad dengan te timpu ni Hari Dabid wey ni Asap, duen e me pangulu te me mangngulahing, wey duen e me ulahingen te pegdayan wey pegpasalamat te Manama. 47 Sikan naa, te timpu e ni Sirubabil wey ni Nihimiyas, migbehey ka langun ne me Israilita te igdasag dan te me mangngulahing wey te me talagtameng te gumawan sumale te ingkeilangan dan. Migteil man-e sikandan te halad ne igbehey te me Libita, wey intalaran degma te me Libita ka me talagpanubad.[fn]

44 On that day, the men were_chosen who would guard the room that's a storage_place for the gifts of the people and the first fruit of the crops, and of tenths. They were the (ones who) collect offerings from the fields of the surrounding towns in_order to_give_(them) to the sacrificers and Libitas because that indeed was what_was_written in the Law. And the work of the sacrificers and the Libitas at the temple was appreciated indeed by the (ones) from_Huda. 45 [xra][xrb]Because they did/performed what_was_commanded to them by their God, and the rites of cleaning. And the singers and the guards of the temple also did/performed their work according to the command of Dabid and of his child Sulumun. 46 From the time of King Dabid and of Asap before, there_were already leaders of singers, and there were already songs for praising and thanking God. 47 So then, at the time of Sirubabil and of Nihimiyas, all the Israilitas gave their gifts for the singers and for the guards of gate of the temple according to what they need. They also set_aside a separate portion for the Libitas, and the Libitas divided_(some)_among the sacrificers.[fn]

Ka pegsuwey te me Israilita puun te me lapu

The separating of the Israilitas from foreigners

131 [xr]Te nabase e ka baseen te Balaud ni Muwisis te seeye ne aldew, nanengnengan dan ne ware iya ituhut ne eglemung te keet-etawan te Manama ka me Amurihanen wey ke me Muwabihanen naa, 2 [xr]su ware dan ma behayi ka me Israilita te egkakeen wey egkeinum te diye pad sikandan te inged ne ware mig-ugpe, su nasi mule migsuul ki Balaam eyew te pegdilus kandan. (Piru inggimu mule te Manama ne panalangin ka seeye ne dilus.) 3 Te pegkarineg te me Israilita te Balaud, impasuwey ran e ka langun ne lapu.

131 [xr]When the document of the Law by Muwisis had_been_read on that day, they realized that it indeed didn't permit the Amurihanons and the Muwabihanons to stay_with the people of God, 2 [xr]because they didn't give the Israilitas food and drink when they were still there in the place where no_one live, because instead (they) paid Balaam in_order to_curse them. (But on_the_contrary God made that curse into blessing.) 3 When the Israilitas heard the Law, they separated_off all the foreigners.

Ka peg-ayad-ayad ni Nihimiyas te timplu

The repairing of Nihimiyas of the temple

4 Te ware pad seini neyitabu, ka talagpanubad ne si Iliyasib ne karumaan ni Tubiyas, iyan impiyalan te me sinabeng ne tinesanan diye te timplu. 5 Sikan naa ka intuhutan din si Tubiyas ne eggamit te dakel ne sinabeng diye te timplu. Ka seini ne sinabeng, tinesanan dengan te me halad ne egkakeen, me meemut ne insinsu, me tahuanan, me igkasapulu te trigu, binu, wey mentika ne sumale te Balaud igpabehey te me Libita, te me mangngulahing, te me talagbantey te gumawan te timplu, wey te me talagpanubad. 6 Wara a diye te Hirusalim te seeye ne timpu su miglibed a diye ki Hari Artasirsis te igkatatelu ne pulu wey daruwa (32) ne leg-un te peghari din te Babilunya. Ne nataman, migpanaha-taha ad e wey intuhutan e red iya nikandin. 7 Te pegginguma ku diye te Hirusalim, nanengnengan ku ka mareet ne inggimu ni Iliyasib ne iyan ka pegpeugpe ki Tubiyas te sinabeng ne tinesanan ne diye te timplu te Manama. 8 Sikan naa ka nalanglangetan a, wey impandegpak ku ka langun ne kasangkapan ni Tubiyas diye te lihawangan te sinabeng. 9 Ne nataman, impalinisan ku ka me sinabeng wey impalibed ku ipatahu diye ka me kasangkapan, egkakeen, wey ka meemut ne insinsu.

4 Before this happened, the sacrificer Iliyasib who was a relative of Tubiyas, whom entrusted the rooms that were storage_place(s) there in the temple. 5 That's why he allowed Tubiyas to use the large room in the temple. This room, (was a) storage_place before of offerings of food, fragrant incense, vessels, tenths of wheat, of wine, and of cooking_oil that according to the Law was_given to the Libitas, singers, guards of the gate of the temple, and sacrificers. 6 I wasn't in Hirusalim at that time because I had_returned to King Artasirsis in the thirty-second (32) year of his kinging of Babilunya. And then, I bid_farewell and I was indeed permitted by_him. 7 Upon my arrival there in Hirusalim, I found_out the evil actions of Iliyasib which_were the getting_ Tubiyas _to_live in a room that (was) a storage_place there in the temple of God. 8 That's why I became_angry, and I threw(pl) all the stuff of Tubiyas there outside the room. 9 And then, I had_ the room _cleaned and had_returned put there the equipments, food, and the fragrant incense.

10 [xr]Ne nanengnengan ku man-e ne ware nabehayi te me baad ka me Libita wey ka me mangngulahing ne migtrabahu diye te timplu, purisu nanlibed e sikandan diye te me kamet dan. 11 Purisu indew-ey ku ka me upisyal te migkahi, “Mania te imbalahad niyu ka timplu?” Ne impalibulung ku ka me Libita wey ka me mangngulahing wey impalibed ku te me himu ran. 12 [xr]Nataman, in-uyan e te langun ne matig-Huda ka igkasapulu ne baad te trigu, te binu, wey te mentika diye te me tinesanan. 13 Ne iyan ku insalihan te me tinesanan si Silimiyas ne talagpanubad, si Saduk ne talagpanulu te Balaud, wey si Pidayas ne Libita. Impabulig ku kandan si Hanan ne anak ni Sakur ne apu ni Mataniyas. In-alam ku sikandan su egkasalihan ma sikandan wey imbehayan ku te katenged ne egpanalad te me duma ran te baad dan. 14 Ne mig-ampu a, “He Manama ku, tantanuri a ubag wey kene nu lingawi ka langun ne meupiya ne neyimu ku diye te timplu nu, wey te me himu kayi.”

10 [xr]And I also found_out that the Libitas and the singers that work there in the temple hadn't been_given portions, therefore they had_returned(pl) to their fields. 11 Therefore I scolded the officials saying, “Why have you(pl) ignored the temple?” And I had_ the Libitas and the singers _gathered and I had_(them)_returned to their work. 12 [xr]Then, all the (ones) from_Huda brought a tenth portion of wheat, of wine, and of cooking_oil to the storage_places. 13 And the (ones) I entrusted at the storage_place(s) (were) Silimiyas the sacrificers, Saduk the teacher of the Law, and Pidayas the Libita. I got_ Hanan the child of Sakur the grandchild of Mataniyas _to_help them. I chose them because they are trustworthy and I gave them authority to apportion to others their portion(s). 14 And I prayed, “Oh my God, look_after me [embarrassedly] and don't forget(sg) all that I did at your(sg) temple, and its works.”

Ka aldew te peggimeley

The day of resting

15 [xr]Te seeye ne timpu, due nakita ku ne me matig-Huda ne migkeles te behas te paras te Aldew te Peggimeley. Ka duma kandan, migdurulan te me asnu te egkengakeen, te binu, me behas te paras, me iggira, wey duma pad eyew eg-uyanen kayi te Hirusalim eyew igpamelegye. Sikan naa ka insaparan ku sikandan te kene egpamelegye te Aldew te Peggimeley. 16 Ne due man-e me matig-Tiru ne nangugpe te Hirusalim ne mig-uyan te me isda wey te nakalkalasi ne me belegye, wey impamelegye dan seini te keet-etawan te Huda ne diye te Hirusalim te Aldew te Peggimeley. 17 Ne indew-ey ku ka me talahuren ne me etew te Huda te migkahi, “Mania te inggimu niyu seini se mareet; ware niyu isipa ne matulus ka Aldew te Peggimeley! 18 Iling ded iya rue ka inggimu te me kabuybuyahan niyu ne iyan egpuunan ne imparusaan ki te Manama wey ka seini ne siyudad. Ne intimulan niyu pad iya man-e ka langet te Manama te Israil su ware niyu ma isipa ne matulus ka Aldew te Peggimeley.”

15 [xr]At that time, I saw the (ones) from_Huda that were squeezing fruit of grapevines on the Day of Resting. Others of them, put_cargo on donkeys of food, wine, grapevines, figs, and others in_order for bringing here in Hirusalim in_order_to sale. That's why I scolded them to not sell on the Day of Resting. 16 And there_was also (some) from_Tiru that lived(pl) in Hirusalim that brought fish and other different (stuff) to sell, and they sold(pl) this to the people of Huda there in Hirusalim on the Day of Resting. 17 And I scolded the respected persons from Huda saying, “Why have you(pl) done this evil; you(pl) didn't consider the holiness of the Day of Resting! 18 It's just indeed like what_was_done by your(pl) elders that was the reason that we(incl) and this city were_punished by God. And you(pl) have again added_to the anger of the God of Israil because your(pl) didn't consider the holiness of the Day of Resting.”

19 Te pegkasagkup te mahaan e ka Aldew te Peggimeley, migsuhu a ne eglekeban ka me gumawan te Hirusalim wey kene eglukatan taman te kene pad eglihad ka Aldew te Peggimeley. Ne impatamengan ku te duma ne me suluhuanen ku ka me gumawan su eyew ware iya inuyanan ne egkeuyan diye te seled te siyudad te Aldew te Peggimeley. 20 Ne kapapila migmanggirehe diye te lihawangan te Hirusalim ka me nigusyanti wey ka egmamelegye te langun-langun. 21 Piru impanpanayan ku sikandan te migkahi, “Mania te migmanggirehe kew due te lenged te batu ne alad te siyudad? Ke eg-abayan niyu seini te eggimu igparakep ku sikaniyu.” Ne puun dutu, warad e sikandan nanlibed te Aldew te Peggimeley. 22 Ne insuhu ku ka me Libita ne eglinis te pegkeetew ran wey egtamengan dan ka me gumawan eyew egmatulusen te me etew ka Aldew te Peggimeley.

19 At dusk when it was almost the Day of Resting, I commanded that the doorways of Hirusalim be_closed and not opened while the Day of Resting had_ not _passed. And I got_ some of my servants _to_look_after the doorways so_that no load could_be_brought into the city on the Day of Resting. 20 And business_people and sellers of various_things overnighted(pl) there outside of Hirusalim a few_times. 21 But I warned them by saying, “Why are you(pl) overnighting nearby the stone fence of city? If you(pl) repeat this I will_have_ you(pl) _arrested.” And from that, they no_longer returned(pl) on the Day of Resting. 22 And I commanded the Libitas to clean them selves and they watched_over the doorways so_that the people will_make the Day of Resting holy.

Ne mig-ampu ad man-e, “He Manama ku, tantanuri a ubag te seini se inggimu ku wey ipapitew nu ka dakel ne geyinawa nu ne kene egkabalbalawan.”

And I also prayed, “Oh my God, look_after me [embarrassedly] in this my work and show(sg) your(sg) great unchangeable love.”

Ka pegsapad te peg-asawa te lapu

The rebuking about marrying a foreigners

23 Te seeye ded ne timpu, due man-e nakita ku ne me Hudiyu ne migmangasawa te me malitan ne migpuun te Asdud, Amun, wey te Muwab. 24 Liware te me anak dan ka egpakalalag te linalahan te me matig-Asdud wey ke linalahan naa te lein ne me etew, wey kenad iya egpakalalag te linalahan te me matig-Huda. 25 Sikan naa ka indew-ey ku ka me matig-Huda wey indilus ku sikandan. Impanlampesan ku ka duma kandan wey impangginit ka me bulbul. Impepanaad ku sikandan te ngaran te Manama ne kenad sikandan egpangasawa te kene ne me Hudiyu, lagkes ka me anak dan ne me malitan wey me lukes. 26 Ne migkahiyan ku sikandan, “Me lapu ne me malitan ka egpuunan ne nakasale si Hari Sulumun. Ware Hari ne iling kandin te langun ne nasud, wey inggeyinawaan sikandin te Manama rin wey inggimu sikandin ne Hari te intiru ne Israil. Piru minsan pad due, nakasale sikandin tenged te me lapu ne me malitan. 27 Egbalaharen ney naan de seini se dereeti ne himu wey pegsupak niyu te Manama ta pinaahi te pegpangasawa niyu te me lapu ne me malitan?”

23 At that very time, I also saw Hudiyus that had_married(pl) women from Asdud, Amun, and Muwab. 24 Half of their children could_speak the language of the (ones) from_Asdud or language(s) of other people, and indeed couldn't speak the language of the (ones) from_Huda. 25 That's why I scolded the (ones) from_Huda and I cursed them. I beat some of them and pulled (their) hair. I made_ them _promise in the name of God that they would no_longer marry with non Hudiyus, including/as well as their female and male children. 26 And I told them, “Foreign women (are) the reason that King Sulumun sinned. There's_no king like him in all the nations, and he was loved by his God and he was_made the king of entire Israil. But nevertheless, he sinned due to foreign women. 27 Should we(excl) just ignore this evil act and your(pl) disobeying our(incl) God by_means of your(pl) marrying(pl) foreign women?”

28 [xr]Sikan naa ka impaawe ku ka sabeka ne anak ni Huwiyada ne mekaamung ni Sanbalat ne Hurunihanen. Si Huwiyada anak te Labew ne Talagpanubad ne si Iliyasib.

28 [xr]That's why I had_ one child of Huwiyada that's the son-in-law of Sanbalat the Hurunihanon _removed. Huwiyada (is) the child of Iliyasib the Prominent Sacrificer.

29 Ne mig-ampu a, “He Manama ku, tantanuri nu ne inlinditan dan ka pegkatalagpanubad dan wey ka me kasabutan dan keykew isip me talagpanubad wey me Libita.”

29 And I prayed, “Oh my God, note(sg) that they dirtied their being_sacrificers and their agreement with you(sg) as sacrificers and Libitas.”

30 Purisu inlinisan ku sikandan puun te minsan nekey ne nakapanulu te me lapu. Ne miggimu a te me balaud ne eg-ikulen te me talagpanubad wey te me Libita eyew egkanengnengan dan ka me himu ran. 31 Impegpehetan ku degma ne egkeuyan te eleg ne timpu ka me kayu ne igpanemeg para te pegpanubad, wey ka me an-anayan ne uma.

30 Therefore I cleaned them from anything taught by foreigners. And I made laws to be followed by the sacrificers and Libitas in_order that the will_know their tasks/responsibilities. 31 I also made_sure that the wood to_be_burned for sacrificing was_brought at the correct time, and the first harvest.

Ne mig-ampu a, “He Manama ku, tantanuri a wey behayi a te keupianan.”

And I prayed, “Oh my God, watch_over me and give me peace/prosperity.”
